Nothing is written to wp-content outside uploads on activation.

retained_sql_statements.S22: EXPLAIN describes the complete captured single eligible SELECT. Binding it as %s or %i explains a value or an identifier, not the captured query. The independent SHOW INDEX statement binds its table through %i and restricts it to current-database/current-prefix tables.
retained_sql_statements.S52: The multi-row Traffic INSERT binds its table through %i. Variable row counts and per-cell NULL layout require generated fragments containing fixed column names, placeholders and literal NULL, with every non-NULL value bound. WordPress value placeholders coerce NULL. Splitting the batch changes atomicity, failure behaviour, auto-increment allocation, trigger boundaries and round trips, so the approved single statement is retained unchanged.
